name: cublas_cublasCgeru_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench cuBLAS test_cublasCgeru_v2.py. Complex64 unconjugated rank-1 update A += alpha*x*y^T via the real cuBLAS ctypes baseline. _random_tensor does not support complex, so x/y/A are built by gen_inputs as (randn+1j*randn).to(complex64). The test fixes m=n, incy=incx, lda=m; x has m*incx elements, y has n*incy, A is (m,n)=(n,n). alpha is passed as a real float (the baseline casts it to complex64). reference mutates A in place and returns it. Requires kernelgenbench + cuBLAS at eval time.
